about_short_description.short_description: Vendy is a marketplace on WhatsApp

product.name: WhatsApp Shop
product.description: A platform that allows vendors to create storefronts on WhatsApp where customers can browse products, place orders, receive invoices, and make payments without needing to download an app.

product.name: In-App Payments
product.description: A proprietary payment solution that enables buyers to pay vendors directly within WhatsApp using various linked bank accounts or wallets, eliminating the need for external payment apps or screenshots.

product.name: Delivery Management
product.description: A service that automates the delivery of both physical and digital products ordered through WhatsApp, including event tickets, online courses, and physical goods.

product.name: Vendy Direct
product.description: A payment solution that provides customers with global access to their funds across multiple accounts or wallets, enabling payments on messaging apps like WhatsApp at any time.

product.name: Order and Customer Management
product.description: A system that consolidates all orders and customer information in one place, enabling vendors to automate invoicing, track sales, and manage customer inquiries on WhatsApp.
